_comment: The WBW trail, baked at build time so the app never spends a routing quota or
needs a network to draw it. Regenerate from route.gpx in the project root;
nothing in the code hard-codes the point count.
Source: route.gpx — the organisers' Google Maps walking route exported via
GoogleMapsToGPX, https://maps.app.goo.gl/TXqetyrqvakUbD8b9 — so this is Google's
own path, not a re-route. It replaced an OSRM foot-profile reconstruction over the
same waypoints, which followed different ways and strayed up to 705m from this.
polyline is Google's encoded-polyline format at precision 5, lossless here because
the GPX carries exactly 5 decimal places.
TRIMMED 2026-08-24: this is NOT the organisers' full track. The full export is 750
points ending west of the university at 20.04570,99.89137; Park pointed at the
junction with road 3303 on the map and asked for the finish to be there, so the
tail was cut at index 490 (20.05671,99.90875). 491 points remain. The Android app
still ships the full 750-point track under this same filename — the two apps draw
different routes until that side is trimmed too.
distanceMetres is summed from the track with a haversine over R=6371000; the same
sum over the full 750-point track gives 8348, against the 8358 the untrimmed file
carried, so upstream totalled it a slightly different way. The GPX carries no
timings, so there is deliberately no duration field rather than an invented one.
